title: Bạn có thể cài đặt nó cho tôi được không?
englishTitle: Can you install it for me?
pronunciation: Ban co the cai dat no cho toi duoc khong
summary: For asking a shop, hotel desk, or helper to install an app, SIM, eSIM, or setting.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Use it only when you are comfortable letting someone handle the phone or look at the screen.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Open the app, SIM screen, or settings page first. Ask, then keep an eye on passwords and private messages.

phrases.vietnamese: Bạn có thể cài đặt nó cho tôi được không?
phrases.english: Can you install it for me?
phrases.pronunciation: Ban co the cai dat no cho toi duoc khong

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Bạn có thể asks can you; cài đặt means install or set up; cho tôi means for me; được không softens the request.

breakdown.vietnamese: Bạn có thể cài đặt nó cho tôi được không?
breakdown.english: Can you install it for me?

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: If the setup fails, move to Wi-Fi, eSIM, map not working, local SIM, or can-you-type-it follow-ups.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at SIM shops, hotel desks, phone stores, cafes, and with someone helping you connect.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Do not hand over unlocked private screens unless you trust the setting. Stay close while they help.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Use Wi-Fi, eSIM, local SIM, charger, map, or type-it cards if the phone setup needs another step.
